shared_guard.name: guard_payout
shared_guard.description: Single guard function shared by claim and disburse. Enforces caps, eligibility, replay protection, approver-revocation watermark, and identity-keyed caps. Any new payout path must call this guard.

checks.name: replay_protection
checks.description: Reject work items that have already been paid (per-item claimed flag).

checks.name: eligibility
checks.description: Work item must be approved and not cancelled/expired.

checks.name: approver_revocation_watermark
checks.description: Reject items where approved_by == revoked approver && approved_at >= ApproverRevokedSince(approver). O(1) watermark check; unaffected items from other approvers or before T still pass.

checks.name: identity_keyed_cap
checks.description: If registry supports identity keys (negotiated via get_interface), enforce max_per_identity using IdentityClaimed(identity_key). Falls back to per-address behavior when unsupported.

steps.note: Only when identity-key feature is supported; follows rotations.
Shared guard: replay, eligibility, caps, approver-revocation watermark, identity-keyed cap.

disburse_path.description: Approver-initiated push disbursement for CHWs who cannot sign claim transactions. Opt-in per attester via a flag on the payout binding; approver cannot push to an address the CHW never chose.
disburse_path.max_batch_size: derived from per-call budget benchmark at maximum batch size; documented in the pool docs

steps.note: Only when identity-key feature is supported; follows rotations.
Same shared guard as claim, applied per item. Also verifies push-mode opt-in on the payout binding.
